text: API requests began failing with database connection pool exhaustion after traffic increased.
The service was killed by the OS after memory usage climbed continuously for 40 minutes and an OOM event appeared.
Errors started immediately after release version 42 was deployed; version 41 was healthy.
Requests to the upstream payment service repeatedly timed out and some connections were reset.
Users received unauthorized responses because the authentication token had expired.
A release completed successfully, but database connections were exhausted and the API returned errors.
Latency rose while the upstream dependency reported connection resets; application memory stayed normal.
After deployment, authentication requests failed because the service was using an expired token.
Memory usage increased on every request and eventually the process hit an out of memory condition.
Version 17 introduced a regression that caused elevated error rates immediately after deployment.
